data.one_liner: Utility functions for modifying, checking, comparing, and generating DateTime instances.
data.what_it_does: Provides helper methods for DateTime objects to easily manipulate dates, check days of the week or month, calculate differences, and generate date ranges. It also includes support for different week numbering strategies.
use_when: You need to perform date manipulations like finding start/end of days and weeks
You need to calculate differences between dates in days or months
You require custom week numbering strategies like ISO 8601
avoid_when: You need heavy internationalized date formatting and parsing (use intl instead)
You only require basic Dart DateTime operations without extra helpers
strengths: Comprehensive collection of date manipulation and checking methods
Handles daylight saving time changeovers for date generation and boundaries
Supports customizable week numbering options via WeekNumbering enum
weaknesses: Limited to date utilities and lacks full timezone database features
Does not provide UI date picker widgets
